dataset.closure: Every accepted optimal continuation reaches its target; optional one-step finite detours also get optimal continuation. No global closure of all detours claimed.

limitations: Development layouts reused; two training seeds; new target identities are held out but their state features need not be unseen. Complete closure only for optimal continuations of accepted roots and one-step recovery seeds, not all possible deviations. Source and point supervision distributions change with branch expansion.

validation.meaning: Conditional on two fixed training seeds; layouts equally weighted. Not a population training-seed confidence interval.

outcome: Hard replay improves training roots to 72/73 for both seeds, but does not improve unseen-layout or new-layout-goal completions over matched uniform replay. Goal generalization not achieved; no selection promotion.
test_result: 42 tests run, 1 platform-specific skip, remaining tests passed.
